name: VINS iteration 2 (beyond CLAVIS-M)

baseline.method: CLAVIS-M c1 (frozen_c1.json): S_final * p_t, admission p_all <= 0.10, m_mem = 2, kind = diff

metric: AUROC (%) averaged over the 3 order seeds (123, 124, 125) of the (ID dev + near dev) and (ID dev + far dev) streams, upstream get_measures

stopping_rule.pass: near_AUROC >= baseline.near_AUROC + 2.0 AND far_AUROC >= baseline.far_AUROC - 0.3, on dev1 AND on dev2
stopping_rule.rationale: +2.0 pt is about 13% of the remaining near AUROC error of CLAVIS-M on dev1 (the previous loop required +3.0 over CLAVIS, about 14% of its remaining error)
procedure: Exploration uses dev1 only. dev2 is evaluated only for a configuration frozen (file + sha256) after it passes on dev1.
Every dev2 evaluation is appended to iter2/dev2_looks.jsonl before the verdict is read. At most 3 dev2 looks in this loop.
The first frozen configuration that passes on both dev1 and dev2 stops the loop.
The OpenOOD test split (already used twice) is evaluated at most once more, only for the stopping configuration, after a separate pre-registration, and is reported as the third use.

not_allowed: reading OpenOOD test images or test-derived scores for any design decision
disclosure: The paper analyses (after the second test use) already showed test results for Fisher fusion p_T*p_t, min fusion, S^a*p_t, pooled standardization and kNN views. These are known; any candidate that uses them is still selected on dev1 and confirmed on dev2 only.
